s.n: North's workshop pelmeni with sour cream
s.note: North runs the workshop at the Pole. The yetis make the toys, the elves think they do
s.how: Little Russian dumplings of beef and pork, boiled and tossed in butter, with sour cream and dill. Mix 250g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 tsp salt and pepper. Put a teaspoon on each of 40 round dumpling wrappers, fold into half moons and pinch the ends together. Boil in salted water in batches for 5 minutes after they float. Toss with 40g melted butter and serve with 150g sour cream and chopped dill.

s.n: Jamie's snow day mac and cheese bites
s.note: Burgess, the snowy town where Jamie still believes
s.how: Baked mac and cheese set in a mini muffin tin, crisp on top and soft inside. Cook 200g macaroni until just tender and drain. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then whisk in 400ml milk until thick. Off the heat stir in 150g grated cheddar, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 egg and the macaroni. Spoon into a greased 24-hole mini muffin tin, top with 30g grated parmesan and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before lifting out.

m.note: Rump strips and mushrooms in creamy sauce over egg noodles
m.how: Slice 600g rump into thin strips and sear in batches in a hot pan with oil for 1 minute. Remove. Fry 1 sliced onion and 300g sliced mushrooms in 30g butter for 6 minutes. Add 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1 tbsp Dijon and 300ml beef stock and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in 200g sour cream and the beef and warm through without boiling. Cook 400g egg noodles, toss in butter and dill and serve under the beef.

w.n: Bunnymund's hot cross bun egg pudding
w.note: Baked hot cross bun pudding with mini chocolate eggs
w.how: Butter and halve 6 hot cross buns and lay them in a baking dish, cut-side up and overlapping. Tuck 100g mini chocolate eggs between them. Whisk 3 eggs, 400ml milk, 200ml cream, 60g caster sugar and 1 tsp vanilla and pour over. Stand 15 minutes. Bake at 170C for 35 minutes until set and golden. Dust with icing sugar and serve warm with cream and a few more mini eggs.

d.note: Icy blue lime slushie with a sugar rim
d.how: Dip the rims of 4 glasses in lime juice, then in caster sugar, and freeze for 10 minutes. Blend 3 cups ice with 120ml blue cordial, the juice of 2 limes and a few mint leaves until slushy. Add 600ml cold lemonade and pulse twice. Pour into the frosted glasses and garnish with a mint sprig.
